Pastor Kyle Ferguson came from a PCA church in suburban Milwaukee and is well-grounded in Reformed pulpit ministry. A solid, confessional, ordinary-means congregation.

score_notes.scripture: Inerrancy per WCF; emphasized in church's PCA identity page

score_notes.cultural: Twice-Sunday worship is a strong confessional marker
score_notes.preaching: Pulpit-driven; assistant pastor in regular rotation
